chunks: Muhammad ibn Musa ibn al-Mutawakkil (may God be pleased with him) narrated to us. He said: Muhammad ibn Yahya al-Attar (may God have mercy on him) narrated to us. He said: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa narrated to us from al-Qasim ibn Yahya from his grandfather al-Hasan ibn Rashid from Amr ibn Mughlis from Khalaf from Atiyya al-Awfi from Abu Said al-Khudri. He said:

I asked the Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) about the saying of God, exalted is His praise: 'The one who had knowledge of the Book said' [27:40]. He said: That is the deputy of my brother Sulayman ibn Dawud.

So I said to him: O Messenger of God, then what about the saying of God, Mighty and Majestic: 'Say: God suffices as a witness between me and you, and the one who has knowledge of the Book' [13:43]? He said: That is my brother Ali ibn Abi Talib.

key_terms.علم الكتاب: Knowledge of the Book — referring to comprehensive knowledge of divine scripture
key_terms.وصي: Deputy/successor — the designated spiritual and temporal heir

ai.seo_question: Who is the one with knowledge of the Book in Quran 13:43 according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Abu Said al-Khudri asks the Prophet about two Quranic verses referring to one 'who has knowledge of the Book.' The Prophet identifies the figure in 27:40 as the successor of Prophet Sulayman, while identifying the figure in 13:43 as Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib, establishing Ali's unique status as possessor of comprehensive divine knowledge.

en.bilal-muhammad: Muhammad b. Musa b. al-Mutawakkil (ra) narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. Yahya al-`Attar (rh) narrated to us. He said: Ahmad b. Muhammad b. `Isa narrated to us from al-Qasim b. Yahya from his grandfather al-Hasan b. Rashid from `Amr b. Mughlis from Khalaf from `Atiyya al-`Awfi from Abi Sa`id al-Khudri. He said:
I asked the Messenger of Allah (s) about the saying of Allah, “The one who had knowledge of the Book said” [27:40]. He said: That is the deputy of my brother Sulayman b. Dawud.

So, I said to him: O Messenger of Allah! [What about] the saying of Allah, “Say: Allah suffices as a witness between us, as well as him with knowledge of the Book” [13:43]? He said: That is my brother `Ali b. Abi Talib.
